description: Claude Code idle after a scheduled task's turn finished ('✻ Cogitated for 9s · done 9:47 AM'), with Claude's greyed next-prompt suggestion in the empty input box. Live, the box's gray border merges with the faint suggestion into one dim run, so the row reads '⟪/dim⟫❯ ⟪placeholder⟫…⟪/placeholder⟫⟪dim⟫'. Before the capture recognised that shape the suggestion stayed a plain ⟪dim⟫ run, the deterministic finished-turn override counted the ❯ row as a newer typed turn, and the phone showed 'running: Setting up a systemd timer…' on an idle pane for hours.
